 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The San Antonio Spurs have a late availability concern before Saturday's game against the Minnesota Timberwolves.
 Stephon Castle has been downgraded to questionable because of a migraine, according to Underdog NBA. The October 31 update puts the starting guard's availability in doubt as San Antonio looks to extend its three-game winning streak.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Castle has not been ruled out. But his addition to the injury report gives the Spurs a possible lineup decision before the teams meet at Frost Bank Center at 8 p.m. Eastern.
 If he cannot play, Julian Champagnie offers a straightforward replacement: keep De'Aaron Fox and Dylan Harper together in the backcourt, then add another perimeter shooter alongside Devin Vassell and Victor Wembanyama.
 Stephon Castle's Late Downgrade Creates a Spurs Lineup Question
 Castle's status introduces uncertainty into a starting group that has helped San Antonio recover from an 0-2 start.
 The Spurs have since beaten the Dallas Mavericks , Sacramento Kings and Utah Jazz. Their latest victory required overtime, with Wembanyama delivering 36 points and 14 rebounds in a 117-111 win Wednesday.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Now San Antonio faces the possibility of continuing that run without one of its starting guards.
 RotoWire, citing Paul Garcia of Project Spurs, also reported Castle's questionable designation and identified Champagnie and Keldon Johnson as candidates to enter the starting lineup if Castle is unavailable.
 The Spurs have already been navigating Tobias Harris' recovery from a calf injury . Their starting configuration has featured Fox, Castle, Harper and Vassell around Wembanyama, leaving Champagnie as an option off the bench.
 Removing Castle would change how that group creates offense. Fox and Harper would have more responsibility initiating possessions, while Vassell would offer another scoring option on the perimeter.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Champagnie would bring a different emphasis. Rather than asking him to reproduce Castle's work with the ball, San Antonio could use his shooting to create room for its remaining guards and Wembanyama.
 Projected Spurs Starting Lineup If Stephon Castle Is Out
 If Castle is ruled out, here is our projected Spurs starting lineup against Minnesota, with Champagnie moving into the opening five:
 PG: De'Aaron Fox
 SG: Dylan Harper
 SF: Devin Vassell
 PF: Julian Champagnie
 C: Victor Wembanyama
 This is a projection, not an announced starting lineup.
 Champagnie recently supplied a strong argument for keeping his shooting on the floor. He scored 26 points off the bench against Sacramento on October 27, making eight 3-pointers in the first half, according to the Spurs' official game notes .
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement As Heavy detailed after that win, Champagnie's shooting helped fuel San Antonio's offensive breakout .
 Starting him would also create a second decision for coach Mitch Johnson: how to arrange the bench minutes after moving one of its scoring options into the first unit.
 The Spurs have an available adjustment if Castle sits. His final designation will determine whether they need to make it.
